name: risk-aware-uav-delivery
description: Code, configuration and results behind the manuscript "Sea-state-aware forecast uncertainty for risk-aware nonlinear model predictive control of winched payload delivery to a moving ship deck". A MuJoCo simulator of a quadrotor lowering a slung payload on a winch to a wave-driven ship deck, with Dryden turbulence, a JONSWAP sea and a Nomoto hull. The risk-aware NMPC, its ablations and the reproduced baselines compared in the paper. The seeded benchmark (twelve condition cells, common random numbers) and the result files behind every table and figure (results/*_d164*). The lockstep MuJoCo-PX4 software-in-the-loop bridge (src/rauav/px4/). Licence: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0, except src/rauav/px4/ (MIT).
